newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX oil prices off after crude hits resistance.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX oil prices off after crude hits resistance.

text.p: NYMEX crude fell Wednesday afternoon after running into technical resistance, reversing gains in refined products which had risen on short covering and spread buying.
"We ran into really key resistance on crude, and we just pulled back," said Warren Tashnek, president of Fimat USA Futures in Houston.
At 1500 EST, March crude was off 52 cents a barrel at $21.90, while March heating oil was off 1.01 cents a gallon at 60.85 cents. March gasoline was off 1.26 cents a gallon at 62.70 cents.
